entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: One of Zendikar's seven continents, a red-aligned mountainous land around a supervolcano, geologically unstable from the Roil.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane of which Akoum is a continent.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: An ancient empire of which Akoum was part.

entities.name: Kargan tribes
entities.description: Fierce nomadic humans of the Teeth who ride dragons they raise from stolen eggs.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: People who gathered at Glasspool during the Eldrazi's return and were beaten by the Kargan tribes.

entities.name: Akoum Skyclave
entities.description: A floating fortress ruin shattered by the Kargan tribes, now broken sky dungeons.

entities.name: Goma Fada
entities.description: An enormous caravan of kor, humans and elves that wanders Akoum.

entities.name: Ora Ondar
entities.description: An exceptional Life Bloom lasting almost a century with an elven settlement tending kolya trees.

entities.name: Ser Amaran
entities.description: The druid leading a cult of elves who eat kolya fruit religiously.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: The founder of the League of Anowon training camp in the Teeth.

entities.name: Zhulodok
entities.description: Whose passage carved the Windblast Gorge.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient beings whose return sent the kor to gather at Glasspool.

events.summary: As the Makindi Empire crumbled, the Kargan tribes mastered Akoum's dragons and rode them to victory over the kor, shattering the Akoum Skyclave.
events.quote: the Kargan tribes mastered the dragons of Akoum and rode them to victory against the kor

events.summary: During the Eldrazi's return, kor gather around Glasspool and carve dwellings in the surrounding peaks.
events.quote: During the eldrazi's return, kor gathered in the area around Glasspool

events.summary: A cult of elves led by Ser Amaran treats the kolya tree as a gift from the gods and eats its fruit religiously.
events.quote: believes the kolya tree to be a gift from the gods

events.summary: Zhulodok's passage carves the Windblast Gorge through Akoum's mountains.
events.quote: The gorge was originally carved by the passage of Zhulodok through Akoum's mountains.

relations.quote: one of the seven continents of Zendikar
Akoum was once part of the ancient Makindi Empire

relations.note: Leads the elven cult at the garden.
relations.quote: led by the druid Ser Amaran

relations.note: Founded the League of Anowon training camp in the Teeth of Akoum.
relations.quote: founded by Anowon high in the Teeth
